<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/plugins/{id}/web-views/{grant}"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



The shell reads the address behind a grant the plugin's backend made with ctx.desktop.grantView, to draw that page for one of the plugin's frames. Only the person (and session) the grant was made for gets it, never a frame token or an API key.
